scope: Data-side latency experiments. Paths are relative to repository root; build/ logs are ignored and hashes preserve their identity. All samples are retained here. Synthetic AXI timing is not a measured FPGA frequency.

counter_scope.cycles: CSR mcycle delta enclosing function call, loop overhead, and final FENCE for store cases. Preparation, verification and UART printing are outside the timed window.
counter_scope.instructions: Existing Synapse32 EX-completion counter, not WB retirement. Memory and iterative-M stalls gate completion. Faulting instruction tokens are excluded after the recorded priority fix.
counter_scope.profiling: 16 MMIO event deltas surround the CSR window and also include snapshot/counter overhead. Events overlap; do not add them into a CPI breakdown.
counter_scope.operations: 65536 ADDIs, loads or stores as indicated by case. stores_sparse also executes32 ADDIs per store; report its whole loop, not intrinsic store latency.
counter_scope.muldiv_wait: is_multiply_divide && !md_done can include a younger M instruction held behind older MEM, because start is gated by mem_wait. Combined performance delta1420200 to1744382 is not evidence of more arithmetic work.

code_path_warmup.observation: First dependent/independent sample has4104/4109 I-cache misses in both physical and baseline AXI simulation; later samples have3. All raw first samples are retained. The reported median is representative of the repeated steady-state path.
code_path_warmup.hypothesis: Four-entry sequential fetch starts a cold not-taken-path miss past the loop branch. Taken redirects drain but suppress stale cache fills, repeating the miss until final fall-through installs the line. This matches4095 taken backedges, but a direct canceled-fetch trace has not been captured.
code_path_warmup.status: hypothesis, not a proven per-request trace
